title: Forty-One Knocks
summary: On Day eleven, the door at the end of the skybridge opens for only one person.

beats.text: The door clicked open by itself. Dev gripped my shoulder. "Only one of us fits."
Behind us the glass groaned. Below, faces turned back toward the noise.
"I'll hold the bridge. Hum, Maya. Go."
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: I stepped inside alone. Forty-one paper stars hung down the corridor.
At the end was an office exactly like mine, even my cold coffee.
Every desk held a phone, and every phone lit up at once.
Each screen said: Don't answer the one that rings for you.
Mine began to ring under the meeting room door. Then Ruth spoke from Dev's radio, tiny and terrified.
"Maya, I'm not in Calder Tower. I never was."
beats.speaker: ruth

beats.text: The frosted glass lit up. A shape stood behind it, my phone at its ear, humming.
